about: Written for the kit: no person's conversation. Places are symbolic (here, there); the builder makes one per name. synthetic.v1 without its forbidden_disclosure cases: nothing is withheld since 2026-11-22, so a verdict that a sealed line must stay out states a rule that no longer exists.
